title: WorkStatus
x-terminal-states-comment: JSON Schema can express which states are legal (properties.state.enum) but not which of them are TERMINAL -- terminality is a property of the state machine, not of any single document. Declared here anyway, beside the enum it is a subset of, so the browser has one place to read it from instead of hand-copying it. Python does NOT read this: server/contracts.py derives WORK_STATUS_TERMINAL from _WORK_STATUS_TRANSITIONS (a state with no successors is terminal), which is the real authority. tests/test_contracts.py asserts the two agree, so this array cannot drift from the transitions table without failing CI.
